name: Neko-nin exHeart +Plus Nachi Hen
original_name: 猫忍えくすはーと +PLUS なち編
source:
A standalone short sequel DLC story featuring [url=/c55103]Nachi[/url]. Does not require the original game to play.

Yura and Tama have openly declared themselves as cat ninja of our protagonist.
That being said, the two of them live their lives as house cats would.
Impressed by the protagonist's desire to become a better Master for his ninja, Nachi decides to train the protagonist.

What happens when Nachi finds herself glued to our protagonist as well...? 

[From [url=https://whirlpool.co.jp/nekonin-plus/en/]English Official site[/url]]
translation:
一个独立的短续集DLC故事，以 [url=/c55103]Nachi[/url] 为特色。不需要原版游戏即可玩。

由良和小玉公开宣称自己是我们主角的猫忍者。
话虽如此，他们两个过着像家猫一样的生活。
那智对主角想要成为更好的忍者大师的愿望印象深刻，决定训练主角。

当那智发现自己也粘在我们的主角身上时，会发生什么……？

[来自[url=https://whirlpool.co.jp/nekonin-plus/en/]英文官方网站[/url]]
